insight.headline: VEL-11 breaks KEP's lines with a 27.4 m pass to VEL-09 in the 82nd minute
insight.why_it_matters: With the score at 2-2 in the 82nd minute, VEL turned a contested midfield moment into clean progression: VEL-11 received under 0.88 pressure and still completed a pass that carried the ball from x 54.9 to x 80.9, adding 0.242 expected threat. Because the pass was completed rather than intercepted, KEP's block had to reset while already behind the ball, and VEL immediately continued into the final third through VEL-03's carry and VEL-08's pass. The value of the moment is less the single pass than the turnover-to-progression sequence it concluded: a won tackle at 82:47 was converted into a delivery into the penalty-area approach zone within the same second, which is the phase where a drawn game can be tilted without a shot being taken.
insight.watch_next: Watch item, not a finding: whether KEP's mid-block continues to allow entry into the right half-space around x 80-96, since VEL's next two actions after the line break also reached x 92.8 and x 96.0.

claims.text: VEL-11 completed a 27.4 m pass to VEL-09 at 82:47 with the ball travelling from x 54.9 to x 80.9 while under 0.88 pressure, and the event carried an expected-threat delta of 0.242.
The pass was logged with a difficulty of 7.2 and tagged as a line break, taking VEL's line-break count in this match to 9.0.

The line break arrived in the same second as VEL-06's won tackle at 82:47, after VEL-04 had lost a tackle at 82:43, so the pass converted a regained ball into forward progression rather than following settled possession.
VEL kept the move alive after the break, with VEL-03 carrying 12.9 m to x 92.8 at only 0.25 pressure and VEL-08 then completing a pass to VEL-05 at x 96.0, within a match pass completion of 0.8268.

The progression came with the game level at 2-2 and cumulative expected threat standing at 19.666 for VEL against 23.5859 for KEP, so this completed break narrowed a territory and chance-creation gap that had favoured KEP.

fan_cards.headline: Level at 2-2, VEL-11 threads a 27-metre pass through KEP's lines
fan_cards.what_happened: In the 82nd minute, VEL-11 won the ball back under pressure and slipped a 27-metre pass through KEP's midfield to VEL-09. VEL kept the move rolling deep into KEP's half.

fan_cards.watch_next: Watch whether KEP keeps leaving that same gap on the right side.

fan_cards.headline: VEL-11 rompe el bloque de KEP con un pase de 27,4 m en el 82'
fan_cards.what_happened: Con 2-2 en el minuto 82, VEL-11 recibió presionado y aun así filtró un pase de 27,4 metros a VEL-09, llevando la pelota del medio campo al borde del área. Fue justo después de recuperar el balón, y VEL siguió avanzando sin frenar.
fan_cards.why_it_matters: Fue como abrir una puerta en una habitación llena: KEP tenía el bloque cerrado y, al completarse el pase, tuvo que rearmarse con la pelota ya detrás. En un partido empatado, ese tipo de avance puede inclinar la balanza sin necesidad de disparar.
fan_cards.watch_next: Ojo a si KEP sigue dejando libre esa zona del campo en los próximos ataques de VEL.
fan_cards.how_we_know: Se basa en el evento del pase de VEL-11 (e-001092) y en las acciones siguientes de VEL-03 y VEL-08 registradas en la misma jugada.
